summary: Iteration 6 covered the three new features (Gate Scanner check-in-by-reference, Reminders + venue_address, Referrals + invite card + landing ?ref) end-to-end. 27/27 new pytest cases passed and every UI flow specified in the review request rendered correctly. One minor bug found: the 'already checked in' message returns a raw ISO timestamp rather than the friendly IST hh:mm AM/PM format specified in the PRD.

minor.issue: On repeat check-in returns 400 with `Already checked in at 2026-09-29T12:38:10.822196+00:00` — raw ISO. Spec expects friendly IST time like `Already checked in at 06:08 PM`. Fix: format booking['checked_in_at'] to IST hh:mm AM/PM in the HTTPException detail.

integration_issues.issue: The 🎉 emoji in the reminder text is being URL-encoded as %EF%BF%BD (U+FFFD replacement char) instead of %F0%9F%8E%89 in the wa.me popup. Source bytes are correct UTF-8 (\xf0\x9f\x8e\x89) — likely a webpack/babel encoding step is corrupting the emoji. Cosmetic only.

action_items: Change the 'Already checked in at ...' error detail in check_in_pass to format `booking['checked_in_at']` into IST hh:mm AM/PM (e.g. datetime.fromisoformat(...).astimezone(IST).strftime('%I:%M %p'))

Investigate emoji encoding in the WhatsApp reminder template — the 🎉 becomes %EF%BF%BD after encodeURIComponent in the built bundle. Consider replacing with the escape sequence \u{1F389} or emoji code.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:462 raises HTTPException with the raw ISO string — leaks precise UTC timestamp and violates spec that promises IST hh:mm AM/PM.
RemindersPanel.jsx:19 defaults venue to 'Punjabi Bagh, New Delhi' if settings fetch fails — this is a duplication of DEFAULT_SETTINGS in backend; consider centralising or leaving blank until fetched.
InviteCard uses `stats ? stats.guests : '…'` — during initial load an ellipsis renders; a tiny skeleton placeholder would be clearer.

ScanPage does not visually distinguish between 400 (already checked in / pending) and 404 (unknown ref) — both show the red 'Not admitted' overlay with backend detail text; adequate but could highlight recoverable cases.
server.py:404 /api/bookings/mine sorts on 'created_at' string — works because ISO strings sort lexicographically, but explicit index missing.
referrals leaderboard aggregates entire non-rejected bookings each call with no cache — fine at current volume but consider a materialised counter if event scales.

rca of the issue: Bug 1 (raw ISO in check-in error): In `check_in_pass` (server.py line 462) the message is `f"Already checked in at {booking['checked_in_at']}"`. `booking['checked_in_at']` is the ISO string as stored. Fix: `dt = datetime.fromisoformat(booking['checked_in_at']); friendly = dt.astimezone(IST).strftime('%I:%M %p').lstrip('0'); raise HTTPException(400, f'Already checked in at {friendly}')`. Reproduction: check in a confirmed booking twice; second call returns raw ISO. Mitigation trivial (~3 lines). Bug 2 (emoji): source is correct UTF-8 but the served bundle appears to have replaced the 🎉 with U+FFFD before encodeURIComponent runs — likely webpack/babel picking a non-UTF-8 loader on that file. Recommend replacing literal with `\u{1F389}` escape in RemindersPanel.jsx line 13 to bypass any loader encoding step.
